description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the RetrieveConnection class within the connectivity command queries. It includes tests for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path correctness.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveConnection, testing JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path correctness.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the RetrieveConnection class correctly implements hashCode and equals methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that RetrieveConnection and its ConnectionId are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveConnection with null ConnectionId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that deserializing JSON produces an expected RetrieveConnection instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that calling toJson on a RetrieveConnection instance returns the correct JSON.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
